```sql
SELECT carrier AS answer
FROM staging.stg_logistics__shipments
WHERE promised_date >= '2025-04-01'
  AND promised_date <= '2026-02-28'
GROUP BY carrier
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) ASC,
    carrier ASC
LIMIT 1;
```
